metadata.protocol: one-parameter-at-a-time around each frozen center; every listed center and +/- point is run under rolling 36m train / 6m test / 6m step with h=192 purge/embargo audit and por_tramo accounting
metadata.decision_rule: PASS/plateau iff every point has aggregate E[R]>0 and no point drops more than 40% relative to that subject's center E[R]; otherwise FAIL/spike
